title: BoxFusion Room-Graph VLN Demo Bundle
subtitle: Advisor-facing room-graph VLN pages generated strictly from committed/public BoxFusion exports. Routing comes from topology_v0_1.json; semantic targets come from committed_room_world_model_v0_1.json; working/lifecycle artifacts are not used as the default consumption surface.

scenes.summary: Primary advisor demo scene. This is the known-good two-floor sequence with 11 public committed rooms, a usable vertical room graph, and stable explicit-room plus semantic-room-summary queries.

queries.title: Explicit room target: room_11 -> room_13
queries.explanation: Shows direct room-goal routing over the authoritative public topology. The route is compact and easy to narrate: room_11 to room_7 to room_13, with room_7 as the next hop.

queries.title: Semantic target: couch from room_11
queries.explanation: Shows semantic-room-summary routing. The system resolves couch against committed room summaries, selects room_3, and routes there using only the public room graph.

scenes.summary: Best current supporting demo scene from the newly available set. It preserves 8 public committed rooms and produces longer single-floor routes than the 2-room 00829 cross-check, making it a stronger backup page.

queries.title: Explicit room target: room_8 -> room_16
queries.explanation: Shows a longer multi-hop room-goal route on the supporting scene. The path crosses five public rooms, which makes the topology view much more presentation-friendly than a trivial two-room case.

queries.title: Semantic target: bathtub from room_8
queries.explanation: Shows semantic-room-summary routing to a bathroom-like destination. The target resolves to room_15 and follows a different public path than the explicit room-goal example.

scenes.summary: Largest current paper-usable supporting scene in the frozen evidence set. It exposes 30 public committed rooms and several long committed/public routes, making it useful for advisor-facing demonstrations of non-trivial graph traversal without changing the query contract.

queries.title: Explicit room target: room_1 -> room_40
queries.explanation: Shows a longer committed/public room-goal route on the largest currently paper-usable frozen scene. The route crosses seven public rooms and demonstrates that the advisor page still comes strictly from the committed/public graph.

queries.title: Semantic target: refrigerator from room_1
queries.explanation: Shows semantic-room-summary routing on the same larger scene. The target resolves to room_39 from committed room summaries and then routes there over the public room graph.

scenes.summary: Compact two-room supporting scene retained as a lightweight cross-check. It is less presentation-rich than 00824 or 00862, but it remains paper-usable and is useful as a minimal advisor-facing sanity page generated from the same committed/public query surface.

queries.title: Explicit room target: room_3 -> room_7
queries.explanation: Shows the smallest non-trivial committed/public route in the current four-scene set. This page is intentionally simple and serves as a compact advisor-facing sanity check rather than a long-route showcase.

queries.title: Semantic target: bathtub from room_3
queries.explanation: Shows semantic-room-summary routing on the compact cross-check scene. The target resolves to room_7 using the committed room summaries and preserves the same public routing contract as the larger scenes.
